project.name: ros2_ly_ws_sentry
project.description: ROS2 Humble sentry workspace. The formal runtime consumes external /ly/aim/* and external TF/navigation, then behavior_tree publishes control to gimbal_driver.
project.workingTreeStatus: Runtime source baseline is committed through a16e1af; this graph and its companion documentation describe DecisionTrace v4, the tactical simulator, and the final Regional Area/Tactical YAML wiring. An untracked LibreOffice temporary lock file is intentionally excluded from version control.
project.lastCheckedNote: Fallback graph source-checked against the a16e1af runtime baseline: JSON retains the complete Regional baseline, while AreaManager.yaml is the final live owner of the four MyArea and CommonCentral scope switches; EnemyArea remains JSON-owned. Tactical.yaml owns the final ProtectHero switch and ProtectCastle: Enable gates both castle sources, RFID gates only self_fortress_gain_point_status=2/3 plus stand-fire, and EnemyPos gates only enemy coordinates in MyBase; other RegionalDefense areas remain active. sentry_all gives navi_tf_bridge the same YAML-derived Chase scope. Safe fallback clears FireCode.FollowMode before FIELD_ALL publication, and Outpost manual goal mode suppresses bridge /goal_pose publication. DecisionTrace v4 records BT-authored tactical evidence plus the last actual control-output snapshot independently from lower-machine feedback; simulator v2/v3 adapters preserve missing evidence as not_recorded. Pygame and /tactical share SceneCatalog/SceneState; mock is the only simulator input owner and manual_ros is observer-only. MCAP export includes decision/control_output/tactical/scene channels. TacticalProtectionPolicy, DecisionTraceControlOutput, and MyBase source-gate RegionalDefense tests passed; simulator suite passed 199/199 after browser/Pygame regression additions. The full node build reaches DecisionTrace/GameLoop and remains blocked only by the installed sentry_msgs AimResult missing four dynamics fields. Static selfcheck cannot fully pass in this host shell because ros2 is unavailable.

analysisNotes: Fallback graph was rebuilt manually from current package.xml files, sentry_all.launch.py, gimbal_driver_config.yaml, SerialMode raw-topic mapping, Topic.hpp, behavior_tree source, gimbal_driver source, navi_tf_bridge source, simulator source, and current docs because no usable Understand Anything plugin core is installed.
Only five ROS packages currently exist under src/*/package.xml: auto_aim_common, behavior_tree, gimbal_driver, navi_tf_bridge, and simulator.

PreRoadland and ReadyRoadland are formal same-level MainAreaKinds. The formal regional profile enables both Default candidates: MyPreRoadland owns BaseGoalId 25 and ends after its configured arrival hold; ReadyRoadland uses the former ReadyRoadLand boundary and retains the ID 21/22 guarded crossing. Old Roadland aliases and the unused RoadlandFollow helper are removed. RegionalDefense aggregates both areas into RoadCorridor coverage. UnitInfo area IDs 8/9 represent my/enemy PreRoadland without changing existing IDs 0-7.

Internal detector, tracker_solver, predictor, buff_hitter, outpost_hitter, shooting_table_calib, and buff_shooting_table_calib are removed; they have no graph layer, node, edge, launch role, or formal topic contract.
The graph is package/topic/file level, not a complete AST call graph.

2026-07-19 AimResult trajectory audit: sentry.aim publishes one extended AimResult with yaw/pitch, velocity and acceleration. Formal BT converts a fresh valid six-field result to the repository-owned GimbalTrajectory and publishes /ly/control/trajectory at its 100 Hz tick; debug.py mirrors that conversion only in standalone aim_mode. The two publishers are mode-exclusive. follow=false, stale input, or any non-finite field produces no trajectory. External aim must keep direct trajectory publication disabled to avoid ROS type/owner conflicts.

NaviRotateControl.SetPostureToMoveWhenFalse is a formal BT-only additive option: a fresh /ly/navi/should_rotate=false overrides only that tick's posture desired state to Move. PostureManager retains the configured cooldown, hold, feedback, and pending/retry ownership; a true or stale message therefore cancels an unsent wait rather than creating a delayed Move command.
2026-07-16 source audit removed the retired local tf_tree fallback; external sentry_tf is now the sole gimbal TF provider.

2026-07-18 source audit moved GimbalState and GimbalTrajectory schema ownership into gimbal_driver; external sentry.aim remains their topic consumer/publisher, while 0x05, TypeID 11, raw topics, and the 200ms dynamic feedback timeout remain unchanged.
2026-07-18 implementation audit added explicit trajectory SensorData QoS, non-finite trajectory rejection, periodic GimbalState publication, reconnect cache reset, and focused protocol tests.

2026-07-19 Regional scope audit: JSON DecisionAutonomy.NaviGoal retains the complete profile baseline, but AreaManager.yaml is the final live owner of Regional MyBase/MyHighland/MyPreRoadland/MyReadyRoadland/CommonCentral eligibility. Its global false clears all five; each per-area false removes only that scope. EnemyArea remains JSON-owned, and sentry_all passes the identical result to navi_tf_bridge.

2026-07-19 Arrival contract audit: GoalReachState is the sole final arrival/unreachable decision entry. EventManager and the navigation watchdog no longer have raw-topic fallbacks; watchdog also removed its independent 140 cm arrival threshold. Default MyHighland, MyPreRoadland, MyReadyRoadland guard, and each CommonCentral point now join MyBase at a 15-second actual hold, excluding transit phases.

2026-07-19 Regional Chase audit: ChasePolicy is a Tactical overlay before Special and only authorizes a fresh official enemy coordinate exactly inside the active yieldable Default task AreaKey when the matching Chase.yaml switch is enabled. Denial retains the Default goal and does not alter aim/fire. League and Showcase keep legacy area scope behavior. target_rel_to_goal_pos_node parses all nine current main-area boundaries; legacy roadland scope maps only to ReadyRoadland.

2026-07-19 Regional posture ACK audit: formal regional_competition.json sets Posture.OptimisticAck=false. Every posture request, including normal Attack/Defense/Move, remains pending until fresh /ly/gimbal/posture feedback confirms it; the existing 600 ms timeout, 300 ms retry interval, and three-retry limit remain unchanged.

2026-07-19 TypeID 9 protocol audit: official 0x0303 uses float meters, while the lower controller uploads custom int16 centimeter coordinates plus keyboard/robot/source fields in the first 8B of the 12B TypeID 9 data; gimbal_driver restores meter values before publishing MapCommand.

2026-07-20 Tactical/Area audit: Tactical.yaml owns the global default gear, the 0->1->2->3 damage ramp, and final ProtectHero / ProtectCastle switches. ProtectHero overrides the HeroProtection baseline; ProtectCastle.Enable gates both castle sources, RFID gates only self_fortress_gain_point_status=2/3 and stand-fire, and EnemyPos gates only actual enemy coordinates in MyBase. Highland, road and Central RegionalDefense remain intact. PointManager is removed. AreaManager.yaml retains SwitchPoint, final Regional MyArea/CommonCentral scope switches, position fusion, and BuffOutpost compatibility. Any BT FollowMode=1 request, including a fresh NaviRotateControl should_rotate=false, remains the final Rotate=0 override. Runtime safe control explicitly clears FollowMode before publishing FIELD_ALL; Outpost manual goal mode disables the bridge /goal_pose publisher.

2026-07-20 Simulator tactical audit: DecisionTrace v4 captures BT-authored ProtectCastle/ProtectHero/RegionalDefense evidence plus the last actual control-output snapshot separately from lower-machine feedback. SceneCatalog and SceneState are shared by Pygame and /tactical; mock mode alone owns simulator input publication, while manual_ros is observer-only. Foxglove MCAP adds control_output, tactical, and scene channels. Browser drag/drop is covered against the control bus and the tactical_board.yaml Pygame smoke renders catalog-owned max HP from UnitArchetype.
